blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a standalone app in the Mac App Store. You can create a shortcut that acts like one. Open Google Chrome and navigate to sheets.google.com. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Choose Cast, Save, and Share. Select Install page as app. This creates an icon in your Applications folder. You can now pin this to your Dock for quick access.

Logistics planning involves massive amounts of data. You need to be fast. Use ⌘ + / to open the shortcut menu. This is your best tool for learning how to navigate without a mouse. If you need to hide rows with old data, select them and press ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. To hide columns, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 0. These small actions add up to hours saved each week.

Dirty data is the enemy of accurate planning. Use data validation to ensure carrier names and status codes are consistent. Go to Data > Data validation to create dropdown lists. This prevents typos that break your formulas later. If you have duplicate entries, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This keeps your shipment tracking clean and reliable.

Google Sheets can handle up to 20 million cells. However, performance drops as you approach this limit. Keep your sheets focused on specific tasks. Use separate tabs for different regions or carrier types. If a sheet feels slow, check for circular dependencies or overly complex array formulas. Freeze your top row with View > Freeze > 1 row to keep headers visible while you scroll through long shipment lists.

You often switch between your inbox and your spreadsheet. Instead of clicking around, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a specific tool is. If you need to format a range, ask Lazur to guide you through the conditional formatting steps. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the data.

items: Hardcoding values instead of using cell references.
Forgetting to freeze headers, making it hard to track columns.
Using too many conditional formatting rules that slow down the sheet.
Not using named ranges to make formulas easier to read.
Ignoring revision history when multiple team members edit the same sheet.

blocks.text: Logistics is a team sport. Share your sheets with view-only access for stakeholders who do not need to edit. Go to Share in the top right corner. Use the link settings to restrict access. If you need to see who changed a shipment status, use File > Version history > See version history. This shows you exactly who edited which cell and when.

faq.question: Is there a real Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no official native app. The best approach is to use the PWA shortcut method in Google Chrome.

faq.question: How do I speed up my workflow in Sheets?
faq.answer: Use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ + / to find tools and ⌥ + / to search for menu items.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to help with my spreadsheet tasks?
faq.answer: Yes, you can use Lazur to ask where tools are, guide you through complex formatting, or dictate notes into your cells.
